description: Get one business's full record by its truvon_id or website domain: each fact with its source and date, every source's value where they disagree, prices, offers, hours and every way to act. Open it for a finalist, and whenever a phone or address matters. A business Truvon does not list has no record.

domain.description: The business's website domain, or its truvon_id (biz_…) from a result; the id is exact when a domain is listed in several markets. Never a name: check_places_results looks a business up by its name and town

format.description: The form of the record: markdown (the default, as text) or json (the same record as structured data)

search_id.description: The search_id this listing came from, if any

name: get_business_record

actions.description: With format json: every way to act, each with where it leads

facts.description: With format json: each fact with its source, date and confidence

links.description: With format json: the addresses of this record, its grade and its field history

url.description: With format markdown: the address of this record in Markdown

website.description: With format json: its own website

title: Get a business record
